description: This file defines a class 'stock_graph' for generating stock graphs as PDF reports using pychart, including methods for adding data, drawing, and closing the report. It also contains a test block that creates a sample stock graph.

classes.name: stock_graph
classes.description: A class for creating stock level graphs as PDF reports, with methods to add data, render the graph, and close the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the stock_graph object, setting up data structures and creating a PDF canvas.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds stock data for a specific product, updating internal data structures and min/max date tracking.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates the stock graph using the accumulated data and renders it to the PDF canvas.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the PDF canvas, finalizing the report.
